title: science entity concept mixin
$comment: DORMANT until the concept slice's final step arms it. Composes over base 2.0. Field set frozen by docs/plans/2026-07-28-schema-closure-concept-slice-inventory.md, measured over 329 authored records in mm30 (285), health (37) and natural-systems (7).

id.$comment: PREFIX only, per the ruling in mixin-hypothesis-2.0: base 2.0 owns the id's shape and the mixin owns its identity, so this stops `id: dataset:foo` passing on a concept while deliberately not inventing a slug pattern. All 329 ids happen to satisfy `^concept:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$` today -- measured, not assumed -- and that is still not a reason to pin it here: the ruling is about the ids nobody has written yet. health_checks/identity_policy.py:207 already reports kebab-case violations for this kind as a finding.

status.$comment: From the DESCRIPTOR (profiles/core.py:426), not the corpus. All 329 records are `active`; a corpus that never exercised `deprecated` is no evidence that it is invalid.

profile.$comment: AUTHORED and honored, same as mixin-hypothesis-2.0. 179 of 329 concepts carry it: `local` (177), `project_specific` (2). Note that ProjectEntity's default is `core`, a value NO concept record carries -- a probe asserting `profile == 'core'` would be passing on the model default, not on authored data.

promoted_from.description: Path of the source file this entity was promoted from, e.g. knowledge/sources/local/entities.yaml
